**UI-for-ytdlp v0.3.3** switches to an onedir Windows build to reduce antivirus false positives and ships a ready `utilities/` folder in the installer.

#### Build and distribution
- **PyInstaller onedir** instead of onefile — app folder with `_internal/` plus `UI-for-ytdlp.exe`
- **UPX disabled** and **PE version metadata** (CompanyName, ProductVersion from `VERSION`)
- **Portable release** is `UI-for-ytdlp-<version>-windows-x64.zip` (full folder), not a single self-extracting exe
- **Inno Setup installer** installs the full onedir layout including pre-created `utilities/`

#### Runtime layout
- `utilities/` is created at build/install time; updater still downloads yt-dlp/ffmpeg on first run if missing
